zh: 模型选择器的每一行标出该模型此刻的倍率：峰价、谷价与限时活动三种状态各有自己的图标，颜色区分贵与便宜，倍数后面跟着距离切换还有多久，鼠标停在徽章上读到「此刻的判定 · 多久后转为哪个状态」的完整一句，距切换不足一分钟时读 `<1m`。判定按各家供应商自己发布的作息表与自己的时区做（工作日窗口之外、周末与法定节假日整日算谷价，跨零点的窗口归它开始的那一天，夏令时切换按真实时刻计算，落进夏令时空档的窗边落在跳变那一刻）；没有作息表的模型不显示徽章，把标准费率整天在走的供应商按其作息表显示。限时活动按文档声明的日期与时刻边界起止（结束时刻就是切换那一刻，已经结束的活动不会再生效）。作息表来自公开目录 offpeakclock.com 的一份快照：宿主半边取一次、在 `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-claude-style/peakrate.json` 留一份缓存、每 24 小时刷新一次，经 `/dsh-claude-style/peakrate` 下发（`POST` 强制重拉），连不上时按插件包里带的那份判定；浏览器半边只在功能装上时读一次，第三方地址不经过页面。构建核对匹配表里每一行点到的那条作息确实在包内快照里、且属于同一个供应方，对不上即构建失败。设置页「输入区」页新增「峰谷电表」子项，关闭后各行的徽章消失，模型选择器关闭时该项目变灰不可操作。
en: Every row of the model picker now carries the rate in force for that model: peak, off-peak and a dated promotion each get their own mark, the colour separates expensive from cheap, the multiplier is followed by how long it lasts, hovering the badge reads one line — the judgement now, and what it becomes and when — and a switch under a minute away reads `<1m`. The judgement is made from each provider's own published schedule in that provider's own time zone (outside the weekday windows, and on weekends and public holidays in full, the rate is off-peak; a window crossing midnight belongs to the day it starts; a daylight-saving change is resolved against real instants, so a window edge inside a skipped hour falls at the transition), and a model with no schedule published carries no badge while a provider billing a flat standard rate all day keeps the badge its schedule describes. A dated promotion runs between the day and instant bounds the document states (its closing instant is the switch itself, so an expired promotion never applies again). The schedules come from one snapshot in the public offpeakclock.com catalog: the host half fetches it, keeps a copy in `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-claude-style/peakrate.json`, refreshes every 24 hours and serves it over `/dsh-claude-style/peakrate` (`POST` fetches again first), and falls back to the copy shipped in the package when it cannot be reached; the browser half reads it once when the feature installs, and the third-party address never goes through the page. The build checks that every row of the mapping table names a profile the shipped snapshot yields and belongs to the same provider, and fails on a row that does not. The Composer settings tab gains a Peak rate meter sub-row under the model picker: off removes the badges, and turning the picker off greys the row out.
